title: A2.2 — Future, Conditional, & Object Pronouns
description: Talk about future plans, make predictions and requests, express what you would do in hypothetical situations, and use object pronouns to avoid repetition.

themes.title: Advanced Travel Scenarios
themes.description: Navigate complex travel situations including emergencies, accommodations, and transportation problems. Handle conversations about delays, lost luggage, medical issues, and complaints. Master the past subjunctive for hypothetical travel scenarios and conditional for polite requests.

themes.title: Arts, Culture & Heritage
themes.description: Talk about museums, galleries, historical sites, and cultural traditions. Describe artworks, express opinions about culture, and discuss heritage and identity. Master the preterite tense for cultural experiences, 'gustar' and similar verbs for expressing preferences, and relative pronouns for describing places and things.

themes.title: Complex Social Interactions
themes.description: Navigate social situations with confidence. Express opinions, negotiate, persuade, and use proper etiquette in Spanish-speaking environments. Master the conditional for polite suggestions, the present subjunctive for opinions, and connectors to structure arguments.

themes.title: Compound Tenses
themes.description: Master haber + past participle to form perfect tenses: present perfect, past perfect, and future perfect.

themes.title: Conditional — Irregular Stems
themes.description: Learn conditional irregulars using the same stems as the future (tendr-, dir-, pondr-, etc.).

themes.title: Conditional — Regular Conjugation
themes.description: Express hypothetical situations and polite requests using the conditional tense.

themes.title: Economy & Finance
themes.description: Talk about personal finance, banking, shopping, budgeting, investments, taxes, and economic systems. Discuss money management, describe financial goals, and understand basic economic concepts. Master the subjunctive for wishes and preferences, the imperfect for past financial situations, and 'saber' vs 'conocer' when talking about financial knowledge.

themes.title: Education & Career Development
themes.description: Talk about university studies, career paths, professional development, and job interviews. Discuss academic programs, work experience, and career goals. Master the imperfect subjunctive for hypothetical career situations and conditional expressions for professional advice.

themes.title: Entertainment & Media Consumption
themes.description: Talk about entertainment, media consumption, gaming, films, books, and cultural activities. Express preferences, share opinions about movies and music, and discuss your free time. Master the imperfect tense for past entertainment habits, the future tense for plans, and the imperative for recommendations.

themes.title: Environment & Sustainability
themes.description: Talk about the environment, climate change, recycling, conservation, and sustainable living. Express concerns about nature, describe environmental problems, and discuss eco-friendly habits. Master the present subjunctive for environmental wishes, 'ser/estar' for environmental descriptions, and comparative/superlative structures for evaluating impact.

themes.title: Future — Irregular Stems
themes.description: Learn the irregular future stems: tendr-, dir-, pondr-, podr-, querr-, har-, sabr-, vendr-, saldr-.

themes.title: Simple Future — Regular Conjugation
themes.description: Add future endings to the full infinitive to express actions that will happen.

themes.title: Health & Wellness
themes.description: Talk about health, fitness, nutrition, and preventive care. Discuss physical and mental well-being, visit the doctor, and understand medical advice. Master the present subjunctive for health-related wishes and the passive reflexive for health procedures.

themes.title: Past Perfect (Pluscuamperfecto)
themes.description: Describe actions that happened before another past action using había + past participle.

themes.title: Past Subjunctive
themes.description: Master the imperfect subjunctive (past subjunctive) for unreal or hypothetical situations in the past.

themes.title: Politics & Society
themes.description: Talk about government, elections, social issues, and citizenship. Understand news about politics, discuss social topics, and express your views on community and civic matters. Master the conditional for hypothetical political situations, object pronouns in formal contexts, and the future for political promises.

themes.title: Present Subjunctive
themes.description: Learn to conjugate and use the present subjunctive mood for uncertainty, doubt, and will in Spanish.

themes.title: Object Pronoun Combinations
themes.description: Combine direct and indirect object pronouns into single words (se lo, te lo, me la).

themes.title: Relative Pronouns
themes.description: Learn to use relative pronouns (que, quien, el cual, donde, cuyo) to connect ideas in Spanish.

themes.title: Technology & Innovation
themes.description: Talk about technology, artificial intelligence, smartphones, apps, digital transformation, and innovation. Express opinions about new technology, describe how technology has changed daily life, and discuss the benefits and drawbacks of digital tools. Master the future tense for predictions, the conditional for hypotheticals about technology, and 'deber' / 'tener que' for obligations in the digital age.

themes.title: Verbs + Prepositions
themes.description: Master fixed verb+preposition combinations: pensar en, salir con, depender de, soñar con.
